decisions.summary: Accept one native process, exit one, zero provider calls, zero retries and complete cleanup as the final attempt-005 result.
Accept both HMR coordinates and runner activation as an execution-path improvement while recording only partial pre-request localization.
Reject every claim that DeepSeek was reached, model performance was measured or native Harness is ready for EMR4 worker use.
Decline Gemini because no code candidate or provider result survived and the closed machine terminal is decisive.
Accept eight corrected or contained workflow and diagnostic observations with none open.

claim_scope: Exactly one native Harness attempt-005 process started and exited one after both HMR readiness coordinates.
The custom runner activated and failed before its first model request with the closed generic code CUSTOM_RUNNER_FAILURE.
The broker recorded zero provider requests and the runner recorded no model or tool activity.
No candidate path changed; retry, fallback and auxiliary-model counts are zero.
Harness, broker and the exact disposable root are absent after cleanup.
The Harness advanced past attempt-004 startup but remains unready for EMR4 worker use.

DeepSeek provider, reasoning, coding and tool behavior were not reached.
Native Harness worker readiness and product-use authority remain closed.
Every attempt-005 identity is consumed and no occupied retry is authorised.

agent_error_observations.expected_invariant: Read-only absence checks must consume the exact keys exported by the attempt controller configuration.
agent_error_observations.observed_error: The first query addressed non-existent disposable_root and evidence_root property names instead of the exported attempt_root and evidence_root coordinates.
agent_error_observations.detection_method: PowerShell rejected the null Test-Path argument before preparation, Harness, broker, model or provider activity.

correction.action: Resolve the exported attempt configuration and use only its actual attempt_root and evidence_root keys.
correction.prevention_control: Every preflight property is read from the controller's exported configuration before composing an absence query.

agent_error_observations.baton_summary: records the unresolved preflight property and exact exported-key correction.

agent_error_observations.expected_invariant: A process-absence reading must not match the observation command that produces it.
agent_error_observations.observed_error: The first broad command-line query matched its own PowerShell command and reported one false process.
agent_error_observations.detection_method: Readback showed the sole result was the observing PowerShell command rather than node.exe or a Harness-owned process.

correction.action: Filter exact node.exe processes before matching Harness, broker, attempt-root or package coordinates.
correction.prevention_control: Owned-process absence readings use executable identity first and bounded owned coordinates second.

agent_error_observations.baton_summary: records the self-matching process query and executable-first correction.

agent_error_observations.expected_invariant: A widened descendant packet must not apply a predecessor's deliberately live-latch-bound selector to the current operation.
agent_error_observations.observed_error: The first widened packet selected attempt 004's provider-free live-latch test while the latch correctly named attempt 005.
agent_error_observations.detection_method: Pytest failed only that historical selector; all other selected predecessor and current tests passed without Harness or provider activity.

correction.action: Freeze the exact three-selector applicability boundary and rerun the 97-test widened and 219-test admission packets.
correction.prevention_control: Every historical selector is classified as immutable-artifact, digest-equality or live-latch-bound before descendant selection.

agent_error_observations.baton_summary: records the predecessor latch-selector mismatch and frozen applicability boundary.

agent_error_observations.expected_invariant: The immutable baseline digest must be asserted by one direct exact comparison with no dead branch or alternate value.
agent_error_observations.observed_error: The first postterminal test draft accidentally wrapped the exact digest assertion in an always-false conditional expression.
agent_error_observations.detection_method: Immediate source readback identified the dead conditional before the test, staging or acceptance packet ran.

correction.action: Remove the conditional and retain one direct assertion of the exact 64-character baseline digest.
correction.prevention_control: Exact retained-evidence assertions receive source readback plus lint and focused execution before staging.

agent_error_observations.baton_summary: records the dead conditional draft and direct exact-digest correction.

agent_error_observations.expected_invariant: A bounded post-HMR runner failure must retain a closed sanitized stage coordinate precise enough to guide provider-free recovery.
agent_error_observations.observed_error: The accepted runner catch discarded the exception and retained only CUSTOM_RUNNER_FAILURE, leaving five bounded pre-request sub-stages indistinguishable.
agent_error_observations.detection_method: The immutable terminal proved both HMR events, runner activation, zero provider requests and the generic runner code with no finer diagnostic sidecar.

correction.action: Consume attempt 005 without retry and open only a provider-free source diagnosis plus closed-stage diagnostic design.
correction.prevention_control: No later occupied attempt may be admitted until post-HMR pre-request diagnostics use a schema-closed sanitized stage vocabulary and pass deterministic validation.

agent_error_observations.baton_summary: contains the generic runner diagnostic gap and opens only provider-free staged-diagnostic recovery.

agent_error_observations.expected_invariant: Every incident-bearing closeout intent must pass the register's closed category vocabulary before its source is committed.
agent_error_observations.observed_error: The first pre-commit intent described the runner diagnostic gap as orchestration_failure instead of selecting the admitted harness_failure category.
agent_error_observations.detection_method: Direct validate_tick_intent admission rejected at tick_incident_category before commit, publication or any Harness/provider activity.

correction.action: Replace the descriptive category with harness_failure and rerun full direct intent admission before source freeze.
correction.prevention_control: Incident category, stage, state and disposition values are selected from exported schema constants and admitted together before commit.

agent_error_observations.baton_summary: records the rejected descriptive category and pre-commit closed-vocabulary correction.

agent_error_observations.expected_invariant: A postcloseout packet must exclude every test whose contract requires the closed operation to remain the live latch.
agent_error_observations.observed_error: The first postpublication packet retained attempt 005's prelaunch-only provider-free check after clockwork had correctly activated the successor latch.
agent_error_observations.detection_method: The 545-selector packet failed only the live-latch-bound provider-free check; all other selectors passed and zero Harness/provider activity occurred.

correction.action: Roll back the published generation byte-exactly, remove the selector from both postterminal command manifests and rerun before republishing.
correction.prevention_control: Closeout verification classifies selectors against the prospective successor latch before intent source freeze.

agent_error_observations.baton_summary: records the obsolete postcloseout latch selector, byte-exact rollback and corrected prospective-latch selection.

agent_error_observations.expected_invariant: Clockwork rollback must use its exact argument-free predecessor-selection interface.
agent_error_observations.observed_error: The first rollback invocation supplied the unsupported --intent argument.
agent_error_observations.detection_method: Argparse rejected the command before state change, then the exact --rollback invocation passed byte-exactly at lease 122.

correction.action: Invoke clockwork rollback without an intent argument and preserve the byte-exact rollback receipt.
correction.prevention_control: Read the rollback CLI help and use the fixed argument-free rollback shape before execution.

agent_error_observations.baton_summary: records the rejected rollback argument and exact argument-free correction.
